gui.mphost: Multiplayer: these settings are set by the host.
tip.enabled:
Master switch for the whole mod.
• Off: no new Circle Hauls are created
• Jobs that already exist keep running and can be finished
tip.delivery:
Loaded train from your station to B, unload there, bring the empty cars straight back and park them.
• 1 car handling (unload at B)
• A converted loaded train becomes a delivery unless it got a third destination or a container swap
• Off: loaded trains only become a third destination or container swap, otherwise they stay normal jobs
tip.pickup:
Empty cars from your station to B, load there, bring the cargo back, unload it and park the cars.
• 2 car handlings (load at B, unload at home)
• A converted empty train becomes a pickup unless it got a third destination
• Off: empty trains only become a third destination, otherwise they stay normal jobs
tip.swap:
Rare job with 3 car handlings, containers only:
• Unload containers at B, load other containers, bring them home and unload them
• Several container types per train possible
• Single cars may have no container
tip.missing:
Chance per car and per trip that no container is on the car.
• Currently: {0} → with 20 cars about {1} empty cars per trip
• No car is ever empty on both trips
• The booklet only shows it after loading is done
tip.forward:
Job with a third station:
• A → B (loaded or empty), load at B
• Deliver to C and unload there
• Bring the empty cars back to A and park them
tip.forwardchance:
Chance that a converted job gets a third destination (A → B → C → A). Rolled first, before the container swap.
• Currently: {0}
• Loaded train: {0} third destination (if B ships matching cargo to a C)
• Empty train: {0} third destination, otherwise pickup – if no pickup is possible, always third destination
• Not possible → delivery / pickup instead
tip.vanilla:
Normal jobs can become a Circle Haul, using the cars that are already there:
• Empty cars ready (e.g. after unloading) → pickup / third destination
• Loaded train ready → delivery / container swap / third destination
• Loading job finished → Circle Haul instead of the freight haul
tip.maxjobs:
Maximum number of open Circle Hauls per station.
• Currently: {0}
tip.licensed:
Only create Circle Hauls you hold all required licenses for (cargo, car type, train length, Shunting, Logistical Haul, Freight Haul).
• Off: jobs may need licenses you don't have yet
tip.time:
Multiplier on the time bonus (all trips + shunting).
• Currently: {0} → 60 min become {1} min
• Loading time from LongerLoadingDelay is added on top
tip.debug:
Writes detailed messages to the UMM log (created jobs, conversions, multiplayer).
• Only turn on for testing
gui.combineicon: Combined icon for the basic licenses
tip.combineicon:
Shows Shunting, Logistical Haul and Freight Haul as ONE icon (DVHR S|L|F) on the job cover.
• Saves two license slots on the cover
• The "Denied" sheet still lists all three separately, so you can see which one is missing
